title: Book a free wheel for an hour
description: As Ana I want to book a free wheel so that one waits for me
acceptance: Given wheel 2 free at 19:00, when Ana books it, then it is hers from 19:00 to 20:00
first_test: Write a test that books a free wheel at 19:00 and expects it held until 20:00.

title: Refuse a wheel already booked
description: As Ana I want a taken wheel refused so that two members never share it
acceptance: Given wheel 2 booked at 19:00, when Ana books it at 19:00, then she is refused
first_test: Write a test that books a taken wheel and expects a refusal.
